name: Grilled Serepok catfish
summary: Red-tailed catfish from the Serepok, wrapped in a forest leaf and grilled. The Dak Nong tourism portal and the 2024 handbook call it a Top 100 specialty for 2020 and 2021. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, and the 2024 visitor handbook. Both place the fish on the Serepok through Krong No and Cu Jut.
howToEat: Wrap the fish in a forest leaf and grill it over charcoal. The dip is salt made with lemongrass, green chili, and forest leaves. Eat it with cơm lam.

The same pages say the fish can also be braised (om), made into chả, steamed, stir-fried with garlic, or cooked as cháo. Those preparations are named. A separate method for each one is Check on arrival.
A price is Check on arrival.
where: Krong No and Cu Jut, along the Serepok. A restaurant name was not printed. Hours are Check on arrival.
